title: Terminal, Git & GitHub
description: The tools every change passes through, on macOS with zsh: how the shell turns a line into a program run (quoting, word splitting, redirection, exit codes, PATH), how git proves who you are to GitHub (SSH keys, tokens, the gh CLI), git's working tree / index / commit model and branch upstreams, undoing things at the right layer (restore, reset, stash, revert, reflog), rebase vs merge and safe force-pushes, and the pull-request workflow up to draining a stack of PRs.
